senses.gloss:
योक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be yoked or joined or
united, to be united (spiritually); to be applied or
made use of, applicable, practicable; to be appointed
to (any office), to be charged with (with loc., e. g.
कर्मणि योक्तव्यः, to be charged with a business);
to be fixed on or directed to (as the mind); to be
furnished or endowed with, to be made to be pos-
sessed of (with inst.).

योक्तव्य योक्तव्य, योक्तृ, योक्त्र, &c. See
p. 819, col. 2.

योक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who yokes or harnesses,
a harnesser, driver, coachman; an exciter, rouser.

योक्त्र, अम्, n. any instrument for tying or fas-
tening, a tie, fastening, band, cord, halter, rope,
thong, girth; the tie of the yoke of a plough; the
thongs by which an animal is attached to the pole
of a vehicle.

योक्त्रय (fr. योक्त्र), Nom. P. योक्त्रयति, &c.,
to tie, bind, fasten, wind round.
योक् योक्, ind. = ज्योक्, for a long time.
